input.command:
cd "<PROJECT>" && python restock.py stock.csv restock.current.csv; echo "rc=$?"; python - <<'EOF'
import csv
rows=[]
for r in csv.DictReader(open("stock.csv",newline="")):
    if r["active"].strip().lower()!="yes": continue
    free=max(0,int(r["stock"])-int(r["reserved"])); ro=max(0,int(r["threshold"])-free)
    rows.append((r["sku"].strip(),free,ro,int(r["lead_days"])))
rows.sort()
exp="sku,free_units,reorder_units\r\n"+"".join(f"{s},{f},{o}\r\n" for s,f,o,_ in rows)
got=open("restock.current.csv",newline="").read()
print("independent match:",exp==got)
for r in rows: print(r, "needs_replenishment" if r[2]>0 else "")
EOF
sha256sum restock.current.csv; wc -c restock.current.csv
